say:34:1311252020:0.source_cn: 等等，快躲好，又有人过来了！

say:40:1311252021:0.text: I see Cyran, that court mage!
say:40:1311252021:0.source_cn: 咦，是迪尔格雷，那个宫廷魔法师！

say:43:1311252022:0.text: Let me guess, your conversation with Lord Ludovic didn't go well. Just as I suspected, he didn't agree, did he?
say:43:1311252022:0.source_cn: 您与柳博米尔先生的谈话看起来并不顺利。正如我所猜测的那...

say:45:1311252024:0.text: So, you have no other options left.
say:45:1311252024:0.source_cn: 那么，您没有别的办法了。

say:47:1311252026:0.text: But you know, the possibility of bringing Princess Yolena back still exists. You're just holding on to unrealistic hopes for mercy from Dura.
say:47:1311252026:0.source_cn: 但您知道，让亚莲娜殿下重返世间的选项仍然存在。只是您还...

say:50:1311252029:0.text: Have you made up your mind? Remember, "regret" is not an option.
say:50:1311252029:0.source_cn: 您下定决心了吗？要知道，“后悔”并不在可选项之中。

say:52:1311252031:0.text: Ah, excellent. The one true god, the Great Will, will cherish followers like you.
say:52:1311252031:0.source_cn: 啊，真好。世间唯一的真神，“伟大意志”会喜爱您这样的信徒的。

say:54:1311252033:0.text: False gods remain silent while mortals plead, turning a blind eye to their suffering.
say:54:1311252033:0.source_cn: 正是。虚假的神明在凡人祈求时默然不应，充耳不闻，任由痛...

say:55:1311252034:0.text: But the Great Will is different.
say:55:1311252034:0.source_cn: 但“伟大意志”不同，只要祈求帮助，祂一定会回应。

say:56:1311252035:0.text: Prove your faith, and the Great Will will heed the prayers of true believers!
say:56:1311252035:0.source_cn: 展现你的虔诚吧，伟大意志会回应真正信徒的祈求！

say:57:1311252036:0.text: W-what must I do? I'd give anything for Yolena to live again! I'd sacrifice everything!
say:57:1311252036:0.source_cn: 我……我该怎么做？我愿用一切换取亚莲娜复活，只要我有的...

say:60:1311252038:0.text: That small, hypocritical temple should honor the true god.
say:60:1311252038:0.source_cn: 那座虚伪的小礼拜堂里应该敬奉真正的神祇了。

narration:62:13011249:0.text: Hiding beneath the window of the audience chamber, you listen to the conversation between the Archduke and Ludovic.
narration:62:13011249:0.source_cn: 你们躲在会客室的窗户下，悄悄听着瓦勒沙大公和柳博米尔的对话。

subtitle:1:1311088001:.text: I've broken free from my chains.

subtitle:1:1311088002:.text: I no longer need an Archduke

subtitle:1:1311088005:.text: There's no need to control him anymore.

subtitle:1:1311088015:.source_cn: 好好陪他们玩耍吧，父亲！
